question: How may the recitation of all Vedas be arranged during the ritual?
premises: Recitation of all Vedas is prescribed.
A single reciter is allowed as an option.
The reciter stands in the proper direction.
inference: Alternatively, one person may recite all the Vedas while standing in the appropriate direction.
plain_english: Or one person may recite all the Vedas while standing in his own direction.
